decisions.reason: As an award-winning flagship Christmas stollen with repeated positive external validation, it has already revealed strong value and is cheap to continue within the firm's seasonal confectionery range.
This bread remained on its own page for two years and fits the firm's core regional bakery competence, so with no clear negative signal the option is still worth keeping open.

The marzipan Christmas stollen continues to be featured and likely shares ingredients, know-how, and seasonal sales channels with the stronger stollen line, making retention worthwhile despite somewhat higher uncertainty than the flagship variant.
